column1: # CID22 (n=4292, 49-ref human-MOS holdout) — SROCC vs MCOS. zensim bakes + reference metrics.
# Reference metrics computed via `zenmetrics batch` on the CID22 pairs (2026-07-15); zensim bakes
# via bake_verdict (bins) / blend_lib numpy forward (npz). butteraugli negated (lower=better).
# Takeaway: zensim's best (2L-H128 0.881, ssim2-only 0.887) sits just UNDER ssim2 (0.889, its
# training target) and well ABOVE cvvdp (0.821) and butteraugli (0.793) on CID22 — while also
# winning non-photo (+0.09 vs B) and keeping a monotonic dial. ssim2-agreement is expected
# (trained toward ssim2); the value-add is content breadth + dial + speed, not beating ssim2 here.
